title: Squish Sneaker
notes: Next.js SPA (Storyblok-backed). No JSON-LD or microdata. Real prices live in a per-currency map in script JSON ({"prices":{"USD":{"price":365,...}, "EUR":{"price":260,...}, ...}). Static-stage price test skipped via structuredPrice:false; Claude arbitrates from PRICE_SIGNALS using the .com domain + USD evidence. Image candidates are mostly on media.occtoo.com (off-host vs page) — they come through as -tag srcSet entries. The og:image (axel-arigato-og.jpeg) is a brand placeholder, not a product shot; ranking it high is structurally correct (strongest signal absent JSON-LD), and Claude excludes it at selection time via filename inspection.
